source.title: A Collection of Problems, with Solutions and Comments

trace.notes: Mapped a 352-page mathematics problem collection with introductory material and topic chapters including Word Problems, Counting, Geometry, Equations and Inequalities, Trigonometric Functions, Sequences, Number Theory, Probability, Problems in Computation, Maxima and Minima, and Quickies. The visible source is a solved-problem anthology rather than a paper or workshop list centered on open questions.

Reviewed the source structure and representative chapter content for explicit or implicit open research problems. The document predominantly presents fully solved instructional problems, worked solutions, and comments; no stable source section functions as an open-problem list, and no self-contained research question was extracted for acceptance from this source as provided.

No candidate was accepted because the source is not organized as a scholarly open-problem source and the scanned content examined here did not yield a clearly extractable, evidence-grounded open question suitable for standalone inclusion under the required schema.
Saved JSON to outputs/parse-paper/adlerbook.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
